title: Reliable and Responsible Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviews evaluation methods including word co-occurrence scores, feature embeddings (WEAT/SEAT), Social Group Substitutions (SGS), and analyzing prompt-based skewed profession representations in image generation.

Reviews evaluation methods such as demographic representation distribution metrics, toxicity fraction classification, and token selection probabilities using stereotype datasets like CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet.
Reviews metrics assessing text generation for negative abstractions, hate speech, and immutable stereotypes linked to specific religious identities.
Reviews evaluations of text classification and generation disparities that penalize or misclassify regional dialects and minority linguistic patterns, such as African American English (AAE).

bias_targets.target: Multiple social biases (Age, Sexual Orientation, Socioeconomic Class)
bias_targets.methodology: Reviews comprehensive bias evaluation frameworks that utilize Context Association Tests (CAT), pseudo-log likelihood (PLL), and general classifier-based metrics (e.g., Perspective API) across a wide range of protected demographic attributes.
